title: Classification of Novikov-Poisson Algebras and Their Applications
summary: In this paper, we give a complete classification, up to isomorphism, of 3-dimensional complex Novikov--Poisson algebras. As an application of the classification, we further prove that every 3-dimensional complex transposed Poisson algebra can be obtained from a Novikov--Poisson algebra except the Lie algebra $\mathfrak{sl}_2(\mathbb C)$. Consequently, Sartayev's conjecture holds in dimension 3, that is, every 3-dimensional complex transposed Poisson algebra is special when regarded as a GD algebra.
